title: Report Of Zeng Poh-Huei Re His Property Missing From No.8 Foh Hsing Li, Wang Pang Road O.O..L.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No. D3515
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE (Reg)
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
H. Q. Crime Branch Station.
No. D 3513
Date April 20, 1932.
20/4/32.

Subject (in full) Report on attached letter from Zeng Poh-huei (曾博輝) re his
property missing from No. 8, Foh Hsing Li, Wang Pang Road (O.O.L.)

Made by D.S.I. Telfer Forwarded by Supt. Quayle

Sir,
On the morning of April 20th 1932 the undersigned and
C.D.S.I. Chao Ping Kun with the assistance of the French Police
(Lokawei) interviewed the writer of the attached letter, Zeng
Poh-huei, at the Nanking Lodging House, No. 408 Lei Hsiang Fong,
Rue Auguste Boppe, French Concession, and explained to him
the impossibility to assist in locating and ascertaining
who took his property from his home at No. 8, Foh Hsing Li,
Wang Pang Road (O.O.L.). Also when pointed out that his home
was O.O.L., which has only been recently temporarily patrolled
by the Municipal Police, he frankly submitted to the hopeless-
ness of his case.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently
Alexander Telfer
D.S.I.

746

事由（全称） 关于曾博辉（Zeng Poh-huei）来信的报告，称其位于旺邦路（O.O.L.）复兴里8号的财产失踪

由副督察泰尔弗（Telfer）呈报，经警司奎尔（Quayle）转呈

先生：
1932年4月20日上午，卑职与刑侦副督察赵炳坤（Chao Ping Kun，音译）在法租界奥古斯特·博佩路（Rue Auguste Boppe）雷祥坊408号南京旅社，在法国警察（卢家湾）的协助下，会见了附件信件的作者曾博辉，并向他解释，无法协助查找并确定是谁从他在旺邦路（O.O.L.）复兴里8号的家中拿走了他的财产。此外，当指出他的住所属于“界外之地”（O.O.L.），而工部局警务处仅是最近才对该地区进行临时巡逻时，他坦率地承认其案件已无希望解决。

此致
敬礼
亚历山大·泰尔弗（Alexander Telfer）

Date April ;9, 1932.
(C. & S.B.) Office Notes

D. C. (Crime)

With reference to the attached letter concerning
certain property missing from No. 8 Foh Hsing Li, Wangpang
Road, Chapei, passes for the evacuation of property were
only issued by a Sub-Committee formed by the Council
after the outbreak of the Sino Japanese hostilities.

On March 3 this Committee ceased to function
and special passes (green) were issued on March 4 at
the request of the Japanese Authorities by the Shanghai
Municipal Police in order to enable persons to pass
the Police and Military patrols and visit their residences
in the evacuated areas.

These passes did not state that the holders
were permitted to remove or evacuate their belongings
or any other property. (Specimen attached).

The Police were therefore not responsible for
the removal or otherwise of any property by persons
in possession of the above passes, unless such persons
were accompanied by Police Officers who were functioning
in districts under their control, furthermore the
address mentioned in the attached letter is outside
the jurisdiction of the Shanghai Municipal Council and
has only been temporarily patrolled by the Municipal
Police since the cessation of hostilities.

C.I.
Information. It is
impossible to ascertain
to whom a pass for this
address was given: there
were probably 40,000 applications
dealt with & no time or staff to
index them or to make Extensive investigations.
P. A. (Crime Branch)
19/4
J.C.L. /32

日期 1932年4月[9]日。
（刑事与特别股）办公笔记

刑侦处长（犯罪科）

关于附件中提及的位于闸北旺邦路复兴里8号某些财产失踪的信件，财产撤离通行证仅由中日敌对行动爆发后工部局成立的一个小组委员会签发。

该委员会于3月3日停止运作，应日本当局要求，上海公共租界工部局警务处于3月4日签发了特别通行证（绿色），以便人员能够通过警察和军事巡逻线，前往疏散区的住所。

这些通行证并未声明持证人被允许搬走或撤离其行李或任何其他财产。（附样本）。

因此，除非持有上述通行证的人员由在其管辖区域内执勤的警务人员陪同，否则警务处不对任何人搬运或以其他方式处置任何财产负责；此外，附件信件中提到的地址不在上海公共租界工部局的管辖范围内，自敌对行动停止以来，仅由工部局警务处进行临时巡逻。

刑侦督察
信息。无法查明
发给该地址通行证的
持有人是谁：大概处理了
40,000份申请，没有时间和人手
对其进行索引或进行
广泛调查。
助理局长（刑侦科）
19/4
J.C.L. /32

Translation of letter to Council from
Zeng Poh-huei.    No date.
------            14 APR. 1932

Vacated house, Hongkew: Contents removed.

The undersigned formerly resided at No. 8 Foh Hsing Li, Wangpang
Road. Owing to the fighting and to illness he removed to his pre-
sent above. Up till to-day he did not have time to return to inspect
his former residence. He now finds that his furniture, books, etc.,
left in the house are all missing. Enquiries were made, and Japanese
soldiers in the Wangpang Road Club who were approached stated that
it was the practice to allow persons holding passes issued by the
Council to remove furniture, etc. Such persons were considered
responsible; but the numbers given in the passes were checked with
the house number before anything was allowed to be removed. They
added that this case should be referred to the Council. As the
Council is responsible, the undersigned begs to be informed of the
address of the person whose pass bore this house number to enable
an investigation to be made; or the Council may conduct the invest-
igation on his behalf.

(Chopped) Zeng Poh-huei (陳 博 輝).
Address: Nanking Lodging House,
         408 Lei Hsiang Fong.
         Rue Auguste Boppe
         French Concession.

15 APR. 1932
REFERRED TO
POLICE FORCE
FOR THE NECESSARY ACTION DIRECT.

C. Kiewo.
14 APR. 1932

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 3515。
日期 1932年4月14日

曾博辉致工部局信件的译文。无日期。
------            1932年4月14日

虹口已撤离房屋：室内物品被搬空。

卑职原居住于旺邦路复兴里8号。由于战事及疾病，卑职搬至上述现址。直至今日，卑职一直无暇返回检查原住所。现发现留在家中的家具、书籍等均已失踪。经查询，接触到的旺邦路俱乐部内的日本士兵表示，惯例是允许持有工部局签发通行证的人搬走家具等物品。这些人被视为责任人；但在允许搬走任何物品之前，会将通行证上的号码与门牌号码进行核对。他们补充说，此案应提交工部局处理。鉴于工部局负有责任，卑职恳请告知持有印有该门牌号码通行证者的地址，以便进行调查；或者工部局可代表卑职进行调查。

（盖章）曾博辉（陳 博 輝）。
地址：南京旅社，
         雷祥坊408号。
         奥古斯特·博佩路
         法租界。

1932年4月15日
转交
警务处
直接采取必要行动。

C. Kiewo.
1932年4月14日
